profile.headline: Software Development Engineer | Slate Auto | Full-stack development

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
•Maintained and improved FireTV's homescreen page load testing. Wrote and tested code changes that improved the reliability of the code and the accuracy of the test traffic. Collaborated with other teams at Amazon to run large scale FireTV and PrimeVideo load tests.
• Automated internal processes saving stakeholders hundreds of work hours using Java, Python, JavaScript, React and AWS CDK. These projects impacted millions of production devices worldwide and
reduced the probability of user error.
• Designed and created full stack applications from the ground up for multiple teams. Collaborated with stakeholders to identify and fulfill requirements. This was accomplished by using React, Typescript, Java and AWS CDK.
positions.insights: Skills: Programming · Git · Kotlin · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Web Development · HTML · Elasticsearch · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · JavaScript · Agile Methodologies · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: SDE Intern
